# Every coding font, set in its own type.

**95 monospace families** from the CodeFont catalog, each with a specimen page you can type into and an editor setup you can copy.

## Found one you like?

CodeFont sets it for your editor or terminal in one click, and keeps the change local.

[Install CodeFont Free →](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=codefont.codefont)

#### CodeFont

CodeFont is a local-only VS Code extension for finding, verifying, and applying monospace coding fonts to your editor and terminal.
